claims: Usher and Chris Brown officially announced a joint "Raymond & Brown" tour for 2026.

The announcement was revealed through a teaser video.
The announcement was shared via joint social media posts on April 10, 2026.
The tour name is the "Raymond & Brown" Tour.

A show is scheduled for July 17, 2026, at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte, NC.
